sources.title: (PDF) Multimodal Zero-Shot and Few-Shot Learning - ResearchGate
sources.snippet: Abstract Multimodal zero-shot and few-shot learning integrate multiple data modalities-such as text, images, audio, and video-to enhance AI generalization with minimal training examples.

sources.title: Understanding Zero-Shot and Few-Shot Learning in LLMs
sources.snippet: This paper explores the mechanisms behind zero-shot and few-shot learning in LLMs, highlighting their advantages, limitations, and real-world applications.

sources.title: edwinliuka/few-shot-multimodal-notes · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Notes on Few Shot Multimodal Repository summary This repository contains a working research note about Few Shot Multimodal. It organizes motivation, related work, a falsifiable hypothesis, and an evaluation plan. It is not presented as a completed paper or a release of trained models.

sources.title: FA-DeepMSM: a few-shot adapted interpretable multimodal survival model ...
sources.snippet: Despite differences in modality and task, these studies collectively illustrate that self-supervised, few-shot learning enables generalizable and scalable model performance across biomedical domains. Despite this progress, current multimodal survival prediction approaches face three fundamental limitations.
